documents.says: x402/client_base.py keeps a payment requirement only when its own amount is within the spend cap; nothing paid before enters the comparison: a threshold on each payment
x402/client_base.py, SpendControls: the client's one amount limit is per payment; it offers no cumulative budget, so no window and no lifetime total

documents.quote: Client spend controls (enforced before policies). By default only assets ``find_default_asset`` recognizes are allowed, capped at ``DEFAULT_MAX_AMOUNT_PER_PAYMENT``.
documents.says: the client refuses to sign a payment above max_amount_per_payment (default $1); the run sets it per session, in the token's minor units, through allowed_assets

documents.quote: Create policy that filters by maximum amount.
documents.says: a policy that drops requirements above a value: a second form of the same one-payment ceiling
the spend controls hold a ceiling on one payment and a list of allowed assets; the exact scheme's client offers no cumulative budget, no per-period total and no count of payments

limits.reason: the x402 client library offers no cumulative budget: its spend controls cap one payment and the assets allowed, nothing summed over payments (x402 Python 2.29.0, client_base.py)

documents.quote: **Verify** the `client` has sufficient balance of the `asset`.
documents.says: the token cannot move more than the buyer wallet holds: the facilitator's /verify answers insufficient_funds and the transfer would revert; the wallet's balance is the last cap

documents.quote: @param validBefore   The time before which this is valid (unix time)
documents.says: an authorization the facilitator presents at or after validBefore must not move money; the client sets validBefore from the seller's maxTimeoutSeconds
